# Srikanth Iyer

> Complex systems researcher studying emergent computation and LLM agents in
> socio-economic models. Former advertising professional and screenwriter with
> a sold feature film script. Based at https://srikanth-iyer.github.io

## Research

- Emergent computation: the conditions under which distributed systems with no
  central controller — cellular automata, swarms, economies — perform
  information processing.
- LLM agents in socio-economic models: agent-based models populated by
  language-model agents that negotiate, deceive, cooperate, and rationalize;
  used as laboratories for studying institutions, markets, and norms.
- Mechanism and policy design aimed at net-positive outcomes for the people
  inside the systems being modeled, with explicit honesty about model limits.

## Background

- Career in advertising before research; wrote and sold a feature film script.
- Sees modeling and storytelling as one practice: "a model is a story you can
  run; a story is a model you can feel."
- Literary influences: Terry Pratchett and Ursula K. Le Guin.
- Holds a strong commitment to ethics in research: net positive to society,
  honesty about model assumptions, and legibility of systems to the people
  governed by them.
